array.string: set -eu /usr/bin/pmset -g | /usr/bin/grep -q 'SleepDisabled[[:space:]]*1' || exit 0 stamp=$(/usr/bin/stat -f %m "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Pilot Light/heartbeat" 2>/dev/null) || stamp=0 now=$(/bin/date +%s) age=$((now - stamp)) if /usr/bin/pgrep -u "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" -qx PilotLight && [ "$age" -ge 0 ] && [ "$age" -le 20 ]; then exit 0 fi /usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/bin/pmset -a disablesleep 0 && /usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/bin/pmset sleepnow
